title: Microsoft AI Academy
description: A hands-on catalog for exploring experimental AIBAST agents through scenario quests, guided builds, evidence reviews, and portable Microsoft implementation patterns.
disclaimer: Microsoft AI Academy is an experimental AIBAST learning experience. It is not an official Microsoft credential, certification, training program, or replacement for Microsoft Learn. Activities use synthetic data and self-reported milestones unless a course states otherwise.

milestones.title: Started
milestones.description: Open the quest and begin the learning scenario.

milestones.title: Local proof
milestones.description: Run the scenario locally and capture evidence that the agent responded.

milestones.title: Draft builder
milestones.description: Create a governed draft from the packaged instructions, knowledge, and skills.

milestones.title: Preview proven
milestones.description: Exercise the draft in preview and compare the result with the course evidence.

milestones.title: Workshop complete
milestones.description: Finish the guided quest and its required evidence checkpoints.

milestones.title: Manual mode complete
milestones.description: Complete the manual build path without publishing or connecting customer data.

ecosystem.title: Discover a skill
ecosystem.description: Choose an AIBAST capability that matches a role, industry, or problem you want to understand.

ecosystem.title: Learn the scenario
ecosystem.description: Use the quest and field guide to understand the people, evidence, constraints, and expected outcome.

ecosystem.title: Build and test
ecosystem.description: Follow the guided or manual path, test with synthetic data, and keep consequential actions under human review.

ecosystem.title: Prove the outcome
ecosystem.description: Compare the result with the evidence report and record what the workshop actually demonstrated.

ecosystem.title: Carry it into Microsoft
ecosystem.description: Reuse the portable skill and implementation pattern in the appropriate Microsoft agent, app, or workflow.
